# GitHub Actions Output Formatter

## Context

When bivvy runs in GitHub Actions, errors and warnings are printed as plain text in CI logs. GitHub Actions supports [workflow commands](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-what-your-workflow-does/workflow-commands-for-github-actions) like `::error::`, `::warning::`, and `::group::` that create inline annotations on PRs and collapsible log sections. This feature adds that integration so bivvy surfaces errors directly in the GitHub Actions UI.

## Approach: GHA Annotation Module + UserInterface Decorator + Lint Formatter

Three components, each building on the previous:

### Component 1: GHA Workflow Command Module (`src/ui/gha.rs`)

Low-level functions for emitting GitHub Actions workflow commands. Encapsulates the `::` protocol.

```rust
pub enum GhaLevel { Notice, Warning, Error }

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct GhaProperties {
    pub file: Option<String>,
    pub line: Option<usize>,
    pub col: Option<usize>,
    pub end_line: Option<usize>,
    pub title: Option<String>,
}

/// Format a GHA annotation string (does NOT print, returns String for testability).
pub fn format_annotation(level: GhaLevel, message: &str, props: &GhaProperties) -> String

/// Write ::group::{title} to stdout.
pub fn group_start(title: &str)

/// Write ::endgroup:: to stdout.
pub fn group_end()

/// Escape a message per GHA requirements (% -> %25, \n -> %0A, \r -> %0D).
fn escape_message(msg: &str) -> String
```

Tests: Unit tests on `format_annotation` and `escape_message` — no stdout capture needed since `format_annotation` returns a String.

### Component 2: GhaAnnotator UserInterface Decorator (`src/ui/gha_annotator.rs`)

Wraps any `Box<dyn UserInterface>` and adds GHA annotations:

```rust
pub struct GhaAnnotator {
    inner: Box<dyn UserInterface>,
}
```

Delegation + additional behavior:

| Method | GHA addition |
|--------|-------------|
| `error(msg)` | Also prints `::error::{msg}` |
| `warning(msg)` | Also prints `::warning::{msg}` |
| `show_error_block(cmd, output, hint)` | Also prints `::error title={cmd}::{output}` |
| `show_run_summary(summary)` | For each failed step, prints `::error title=Step failed::{name}` |
| All other methods | Pure delegation to inner |

Key design decisions:
- Annotations emit regardless of OutputMode (they're CI metadata, not user output)
- `GhaAnnotator` implements `UserInterface` by delegating all 15+ trait methods
- No `::group::` wrapping for now (keeps it simple; can add later)

### Component 3: GHA Lint Formatter (`src/lint/output/gha.rs`)

New `LintFormatter` implementation for `bivvy lint --format gha`:

```rust
pub struct GhaFormatter;

impl LintFormatter for GhaFormatter {
    fn format<W: Write>(&self, diagnostics: &[LintDiagnostic], writer: &mut W) -> io::Result<()> {
        // For each diagnostic, emit:
        // ::error file={file},line={line},title={rule_id}::{message}
    }
}
```

Reuses `gha::format_annotation` from Component 1.

### Component 4: CLI Integration

**`src/cli/args.rs`** — Add `--gha` global flag:
```rust
#[arg(long, global = true)]
pub gha: bool,
```

**`src/shell/platform.rs`** — Add `is_github_actions()`:
```rust
pub fn is_github_actions() -> bool {
    std::env::var("GITHUB_ACTIONS").is_ok()
}
```

**`src/ui/terminal.rs`** — Update `create_ui` to accept GHA flag:
```rust
pub fn create_ui(interactive: bool, mode: OutputMode, gha: bool) -> Box<dyn UserInterface>
```

**`src/main.rs`** — Wire detection:
```rust
let gha_mode = cli.gha || is_github_actions();
let mut ui = create_ui(is_interactive, output_mode, gha_mode);
```

**`src/cli/commands/lint.rs`** — Add `"gha"` format branch in `format_output()`.

## Files to Create

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/ui/gha.rs` | GHA workflow command formatting + escaping |
| `src/ui/gha_annotator.rs` | `UserInterface` decorator that adds `::error::`/`::warning::` |
| `src/lint/output/gha.rs` | `LintFormatter` for `--format gha` |

## Files to Modify

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/ui/mod.rs` | Add `pub mod gha; pub mod gha_annotator;` and re-exports |
| `src/ui/terminal.rs` | Add `gha: bool` param to `create_ui`, wrap with `GhaAnnotator` |
| `src/shell/platform.rs` | Add `is_github_actions()` function |
| `src/shell/mod.rs` | Re-export `is_github_actions` |
| `src/cli/args.rs` | Add `--gha` global flag |
| `src/main.rs` | Wire GHA detection into `create_ui` call |
| `src/lint/output/mod.rs` | Add `pub mod gha;`, `Gha` variant to `OutputFormat`, re-export |
| `src/lint/mod.rs` | Re-export `GhaFormatter` |
| `src/cli/commands/lint.rs` | Add `"gha"` branch in `format_output()` |

## Commit Sequence

1. **Add GHA workflow command module** — `src/ui/gha.rs` + `is_github_actions()` + module registration + tests
2. **Add GHA lint formatter** — `src/lint/output/gha.rs` + lint command integration + tests
3. **Add GhaAnnotator UI decorator** — `src/ui/gha_annotator.rs` + tests
4. **Wire GHA mode into CLI** — `--gha` flag, `create_ui` update, `main.rs` auto-detection + tests

## Verification

```bash
cargo test --all-features
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo fmt -- --check
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features

# Manual verification:
GITHUB_ACTIONS=true cargo run -- lint --format gha   # Should emit ::error:: / ::warning::
GITHUB_ACTIONS=true cargo run -- run                  # Errors should produce ::error:: annotations
cargo run -- --gha lint --format gha                  # Explicit --gha flag
```
